correctness.rationale: The hop maps x>y to y′≤x′+1; arrivals/exits also preserve that inequality. From (j,j) one can reach (j+1,j+1) via an arrival, hop and arrival, passing through (j,j+1); further arrivals reach all other states with x≥y from (y,y). Exiting to y=0 and alternating a hop and exit drains any remaining upstream stock, including from outside the class. Thus the recurrent support and uniqueness hold for t>0. In a separate symbolic solve I constructed the full generator on (c+1)² states, replaced one adjoint equation by normalization, solved over the polynomial domain, checked all unchanged balance equations, and recovered supports 4, 8, 13 and all three rational covariances identically. Replay: `python /workspace/review_replay.py 2`. At t=1 the exact fractions are −1/25, −1/45, 1/1024. The capacity-two cubic and capacity-three septic in RESULT.md have exactly one positive sign variation and positive leading coefficient; the former changes sign across the rational enclosure and the latter stays negative at zero and at one (−8). With the strictly positive denominators this proves the stated signs, not a parameter grid inference. Only simultaneous stationary covariance at equal rates 0<t≤1 for the stated capacities is established. The supplied exact balance verifier was inspected, not executed.
